diagnostic_secondary_boundaries.name: treatment of used cable
diagnostic_secondary_boundaries.basis: The native inventory explicitly describes secondary copper from cable separation with allocation to cable disposal; no new virgin extraction belongs on this recovered output in the cut-off model.
diagnostic_secondary_boundaries.source: Native ecoinvent treatment of used cable / copper, cathode documentation

diagnostic_secondary_boundaries.name: treatment of non-Fe-Co-metals, from used Li-ion battery, hydrometallurgical processing
diagnostic_secondary_boundaries.basis: The native inventory documents recovery from used battery materials and removal of primary copper mining and extraction from its process proxy. Its remaining recycling recipe is preserved.
diagnostic_secondary_boundaries.source: Native ecoinvent used-battery hydrometallurgical treatment / copper, cathode documentation

diagnostic_secondary_boundaries.name: treatment of non-Fe-Co-metals, from used Li-ion battery, pyrometallurgical processing
diagnostic_secondary_boundaries.basis: The native inventory documents recovery from the non-Fe-Co fraction of used batteries using a secondary metal-recovery proxy. This is a secondary-supply boundary, not a validation of its recipe or recovery yield.
diagnostic_secondary_boundaries.source: Native ecoinvent used-battery pyrometallurgical treatment / copper, cathode documentation

source_retained_carrier_targets.name: cobalt production
source_retained_carrier_targets.basis: This cradle-to-gate cobalt-industry aggregate includes extraction directly and has no copper-bearing material feed. Retain its supplied allocated Copper resource amount while clearing other co-mined metals; no replacement copper boundary exists downstream for this branch. The retained amount is not an anode-purity assay and is not normalized to one kilogram.
source_retained_carrier_targets.source: Native ecoinvent cobalt production / copper, anode inventory and its 2016 Cobalt Development Institute/ERM source documentation
